title: Customer Terms for Storage Tenants: Late-Fee Rebate on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
A tenant who also rents storage from the company under a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement receives a bundled-tenant rebate off a late fee on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement:

- **$5.00** for a tenant who also holds an active storage unit rental moved into at least 24 months before the handling date;
- **$2.50** for a tenant whose active storage unit rental was moved into more recently;
- nothing for a tenant with no active storage unit rental.

Months are whole calendar months from the storage unit's move-in date to the handling date, counted to the same day of the later month. The records read are the tenant's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement status (active) and move-in date.

**Where the rebate is taken.** The rebate is taken off the late fee after the fee has been kept within the class's late-fee ceiling and multiplied by anything it is multiplied by, and before the fee is compared with the minimum below which it is not charged; the fee is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Storage unit record | Rebate |
|---|---|
| Active, moved in 24 months ago or longer | $5.00 |
| Active, moved in under 24 months ago | $2.50 |
| None active | nothing |

Hypothetical illustration: a fee of $37.50 for a tenant whose active storage unit was moved into 26 months ago becomes $32.50 before the minimum comparison; at 23 months it becomes $35.00.
